segment.description: Spring Creek (GNIS 01327083) in Polk County per the catalog: the TWRA-stocked creek in the Coker Creek/Reliance area that enters the Hiwassee River at Reliance. Identity verified against the catalog this session: TDEC station TDECWR_WQX-TNW000005903 'Spring Creek' sits at 35.2240, -84.5129 in Polk County (county 139), HUC-8 06020002 (Hiwassee), matching the Reliance-mouth creek — distinct from the Blount County Spring Creek (Calderwood area) and the McMinn County Spring Creek (HUC 06020003) that share the name.
segment.boundaries: Polk County creek from the Coker Creek area to the Hiwassee River confluence at Reliance; full named creek per catalog (no sub-reach boundaries documented).

coldSource.notes: Cherokee NF / Hiwassee-side valley creek; no dam and no spring-influence documentation found for the creek itself. Historic USGS stations 03556990 'near Reliance' (site visits 1943-1963) and 03556991 'at mouth near Reliance' confirm the course; no active gauge.

holdover.detail: No holdover record found — no TWRA stocking-location GIS holdover notes, creel data, or acceptable independent angler agreement was located for this creek.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout presence documented: the creek is absent from TWRA's trout-regulations lists (0 'Spring Creek' hits on the wild/special/DH page — the wild list carries no Polk County Spring Creek entry) and no fish-community survey was located. Trout presence rests entirely on the stocking program.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TWRA's 2026 schedule stocks this creek as a seasonal put-and-take (Feb-Apr plus Nov weeks, no summer events) and TDEC grabs at the Reliance reach recorded 23.9-25.1 degC in July-August of 2017 and 2022 — warm summer water on a seasonal-program creek.
